templates.note: The appeal to the Commissioner (Appeals), the ITAT, CESTAT or the GST appellate authority.

templates.title: Reply to a notice

proceedings.title: ITAT appeal
provisions: Sections 253 and 254 of the Income-tax Act, 1961

workflow.text: Read the assessment order and the demand.
Draft the grounds of appeal from the record.
Review the draft against the record.

intakeQuestions: What did the assessing officer decide and on what material?
Was the tax and the interest paid or stayed?
Is there a limitation or a condonation question?
evidence: The demand and the stay record

terms.meaning: One legal or factual challenge to the order, tied to its record.

proceedings.title: GST appeal
provisions: Sections 107 and 112 of the Central Goods and Services Tax Act, 2017

workflow.text: Read the show-cause notice and the order.
Draft the reply or the appeal.
Review the draft against the record.

intakeQuestions: What is the demand and its basis?
Was the reply and the personal hearing given?
evidence: The reply and the hearing record

terms.meaning: The part of the demand the statute requires before the appeal is entertained.
The tax, interest and penalty the order requires the assessee to pay.
